source.title: How to Properly Style and Wear Air Jordan 1s (Complex)

tips.text: With bold sneakers like Jordan 1s, keep the rest of the outfit neutral (black, white, grey) so the shoes stand out.
tips.why: Neutral basics pair cleanly with colourful sneakers.

tips.text: Don't match every piece to the sneakers; echo the shoe colourway in one piece only, such as a cap, a bag or the print of a tee.
A graphic tee with subtle details in the sneakers' colours ties the outfit together better than a bright tee that competes with them.
tips.why: Subtle colour echoes connect top and shoes.

tips.text: With high-top sneakers, wear trousers that just touch the tongue with a slight break; avoid hems that bunch over the shoe.
tips.why: The shoe stays visible and the hem looks tidy.

tips.text: Skinny trousers make chunky high-tops look oversized; straight, tapered or roomy cuts balance them.
tips.why: Tight hems make the shoe look too big.

tips.text: Roomy work pants and cargo trousers go well with high-top basketball sneakers.
tips.why: Wider legs balance the bulk of the shoe.

tips.text: Elastic-cuffed joggers belong to sweatpants; denim or khaki joggers with high-tops look dated.
tips.why: Cuffed non-sweat trousers look like a past trend.

tips.text: With shorts and high-top sneakers, wear plain white or black crew socks, never no-show socks.
tips.why: Bare ankles above a high-top look awkward.

tips.text: Relaxed tailored trousers can be dressed up while still working with clean high-top sneakers.
tips.why: A slouchy cut bridges tailoring and sneakers.

outfits.outfit: tshirt white regular casual, jeans denim straight casual, sneakers red streetwear +high-top
outfits.why: Neutral tee and denim let the sneakers lead.

outfits.outfit: tshirt black regular casual, jeans black slim casual, sneakers red streetwear +high-top
outfits.why: Black tee and black denim are a clean base for colourful high-tops.

outfits.outfit: tshirt black streetwear +graphic, jeans denim straight casual, sneakers black streetwear +high-top
outfits.why: A graphic tee that picks up the sneakers' colours ties the outfit together.

outfits.outfit: tshirt white casual, trousers black baggy streetwear +workwear, sneakers black streetwear +high-top
outfits.why: Roomy work trousers balance the high-tops.

outfits.outfit: tshirt grey casual, trousers beige baggy streetwear +cargo, sneakers white streetwear +high-top
outfits.why: Khaki cargo trousers with a baggy fit suit the sneakers.

outfits.outfit: tshirt white casual, shorts black sporty +mesh, sneakers red streetwear +high-top
outfits.why: Simple knee-length shorts keep the focus on the shoes.

outfits.outfit: tshirt white casual, joggers beige casual +elastic-cuff, sneakers red streetwear +high-top
outfits.why: Khaki joggers with elastic cuffs look dated with high-tops.

outfits.outfit: tshirt red casual, trousers red casual, sneakers red streetwear +high-top
outfits.why: Matching every piece to the shoes looks cheesy.
